levels.title: Everyday Greetings
levels.description: Foundational greetings and polite expressions in daily Japanese interactions.
goals: Recognise hello, thank you, excuse me, yes, and no

levels.title: Self Introductions
levels.description: Introduce yourself and ask basic identification questions.
goals: Introduce yourself with わたしは 〜 です and ask basic questions

levels.title: Konbini & Ordering
levels.description: Essential phrases for ordering food and asking item prices.
goals: Order items with 〜を ください and ask prices with いくら ですか

levels.title: Station & Travel
levels.description: Navigation, asking directions, and buying tickets for travel.
goals: Ask directions with 〜は どこ ですか and talk about destinations

levels.title: Ramen & Dining
levels.description: Dining out, ordering ramen politely, and requesting the bill.
goals: Order food politely with 〜を おねがいします and ask for the bill

levels.title: Daily Routines & Time
levels.description: Express time expressions and common daily actions.
goals: Express time (now, today, tomorrow) and daily actions (eat, drink)

levels.title: Foundational Kanji & Daily Expressions I
levels.description: Core N5 kanji characters and essential daily expressions.
goals: Read foundational N5 kanji and recognise basic compound vocabulary

levels.title: Foundational Kanji & Daily Expressions II
levels.description: Building essential kanji literacy and conversational vocabulary.
goals: Expand basic kanji character recognition and everyday vocabulary

levels.title: Everyday Objects & Locations
levels.description: Vocabulary and kanji for common physical items and locations.
goals: Identify common objects and spatial references in Japanese

levels.title: Numbers, Dates & Times
levels.description: Numerical expressions, calendar dates, and time vocabulary.
goals: Master Japanese numbers, days of the week, and time terms

levels.title: Family, People & Descriptors
levels.description: Describing people, family relations, and basic attributes.
goals: Describe people, relations, and foundational physical traits

levels.title: Basic Actions & Movement Verbs
levels.description: Action verbs and direction words in everyday contexts.
goals: Use essential action verbs and understand common directions

levels.title: Food, Drink & Shopping Terms
levels.description: Culinary vocabulary and commercial transaction terms.
goals: Navigate dining and retail situations with appropriate vocabulary

levels.title: Weather, Nature & Seasons
levels.description: Seasonal changes, weather conditions, and natural phenomena.
goals: Describe weather, seasons, and natural surroundings in Japanese

levels.title: Essential N5 Consolidation
levels.description: Review and consolidation of all core JLPT N5 kanji and vocabulary.
goals: Consolidate foundational N5 kanji literacy and practical vocabulary
